hold_reason: Refund mismatch: W2 reported refunds applied for order_ids 231 (17910 cents), 234 (4004 cents), and 235 (1660 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty ledger. Net balances for birch (orders 231, 234) and cobalt (order 235) may be overstated, and payouts cannot be recalled. Please confirm whether the refunds were written to the shared ledger before resuming.
